title: 08 · nandi_faces · Why Nandi Faces the Shrine
lines: In every Shiva temple, the bull looks at only one thing.
He has not looked away in thousands of years.
The only child of an old sage who had prayed his whole life for a son.
Then two wise men looked at the child and went quiet.
He will not live to see his eighth year.
"He will not live to see his eighth year."
He walked to the river, sat down,
and began to say one name.
He did not ask to live.
He just did not want to stop looking.
Let me stay near you. Always.
So Shiva made him the keeper of his door,
and gave him his own form to carry him.
Now whatever you whisper in his ear, he carries inside.
Because he is the one who never looks away.
Attention is devotion. That is sadhana.
